description: Finish picking a pick list — the pick screen's Complete button. mode=complete (default) needs every line fully picked; mode=partial closes the list with what has been picked so far and leaves the rest unpicked on the order. The picked units are confirmed on the order and handed to packing (a ship list, when the account creates them on pick completion — see list_ship_lists). A work order moves to ready-for-production once all its pick lists are complete. Two-step: preview=true, then commit with the previewReceipt.

clientId.description: Optional client id (GUID) for operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

mode.description: complete (default; every line fully picked) or partial.

pickListId.description: Pick list id (GUID) or number from list_pick_lists.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is written until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit.

name: complete_pick_list
title: Complete Pick List
